description: Align ERVMER34-1 primate and carnivore orthologs across the Q432/R433 site, stalk and TM; quantify conservation and scan for furin consensus
code:
import requests, json, re
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

accs = ['Q9H9K5','A0A2J8PEJ9','A0A2I2YPB3','A0A6D2WYU5','G1SA37','F7HQY4','A0A8D2G5H9',
        'A0A8C9I9R4','A0A6J3HIX9','A0ABI7VYX2','A0A9V1GMN7']
names = {'Q9H9K5':'Homo sapiens','A0A2J8PEJ9':'Pan troglodytes','A0A2I2YPB3':'Gorilla gorilla',
 'A0A6D2WYU5':'Pongo abelii','G1SA37':'Nomascus leucogenys','F7HQY4':'Macaca mulatta',
 'A0A8D2G5H9':'Theropithecus gelada','A0A8C9I9R4':'Piliocolobus tephrosceles',
 'A0A6J3HIX9':'Sapajus apella (NWM)','A0ABI7VYX2':'Felis catus (outgroup)','A0A9V1GMN7':'Panthera pardus (outgroup)'}
clade = {'Q9H9K5':'hominoid','A0A2J8PEJ9':'hominoid','A0A2I2YPB3':'hominoid','A0A6D2WYU5':'hominoid',
 'G1SA37':'hominoid','F7HQY4':'catarrhine OWM','A0A8D2G5H9':'catarrhine OWM','A0A8C9I9R4':'catarrhine OWM',
 'A0A6J3HIX9':'platyrrhine NWM','A0ABI7VYX2':'carnivore','A0A9V1GMN7':'carnivore'}

S={}
for a in accs:
    t = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta", timeout=60).text
    S[a] = "".join(t.split("\n")[1:])
hum = S['Q9H9K5']

# simple affine-free Needleman-Wunsch (BLOSUM-lite: match/mismatch) on a focused window
def nw(a,b,gap=-6):
    # identity scoring, sufficient for >70% identical orthologs
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    sc=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=int)
    sc[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap; sc[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap
    ptr[:,0]=1; ptr[0,:]=2; ptr[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for jj in range(1,m+1):
            d=sc[i-1,jj-1]+(4 if ai==b[jj-1] else -2)
            u=sc[i-1,jj]+gap; l=sc[i,jj-1]+gap
            best=max(d,u,l); sc[i,jj]=best
            ptr[i,jj]= 0 if best==d else (1 if best==u else 2)
    A=[];B=[];i,jj=n,m
    while i>0 or jj>0:
        p=ptr[i,jj]
        if p==0: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append(b[jj-1]);i-=1;jj-=1
        elif p==1: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1
        else: A.append('-');B.append(b[jj-1]);jj-=1
    return "".join(A[::-1]),"".join(B[::-1])

# window: human 415-515 covers P-side context, full stalk, and TM start
w0,w1 = 415, 515
hw = hum[w0-1:w1]
print(f"Human window {w0}-{w1} ({len(hw)} aa):\n{hw}\n")
print("index map: Q432 is at window offset", 432-w0, "; TM starts at offset", 489-w0)

rows={}
for a in accs:
    if a=='Q9H9K5': rows[a]=hw; continue
    # align full seqs is slow; align human window to ortholog 380-560 slice
    sub = S[a][max(0,w0-60):min(len(S[a]), w1+60)]
    A,B = nw(hw, sub)
    # project: walk alignment, keep ortholog chars aligned to human window positions
    out=[]; 
    for ca,cb in zip(A,B):
        if ca!='-': out.append(cb)
    rows[a]="".join(out)

print("\n=== Alignment of the cleavage site + stalk + TM (human numbering) ===")
print(f"{'pos':<26}{''.join(str((w0+i)//100%10) if (w0+i)%10==0 else ' ' for i in range(len(hw)))}")
hdr=''.join('|' if (w0+i)%10==0 else ' ' for i in range(len(hw)))
print(f"{'':<26}{hdr}")
for a in accs:
    mark = ''
    print(f"{names[a][:24]:<26}{rows[a]}")
ruler = ''.join('^' if (w0+i) in (432,433) else ('T' if 489<=(w0+i)<=509 else '.') for i in range(len(hw)))
print(f"{'site(^) / TM(T)':<26}{ruler}")

# per-position identity to human
ident = []
for i in range(len(hw)):
    col=[rows[a][i] if i<len(rows[a]) else '-' for a in accs]
    ident.append(sum(1 for c in col[1:] if c==hw[i])/ (len(accs)-1))
ident=np.array(ident)

print("\n=== Conservation at and around the scissile bond ===")
for p in range(426,442):
    i=p-w0
    col=''.join(rows[a][i] if i<len(rows[a]) else '-' for a in accs)
    print(f"  {p:>4} {hum[p-1]}  orthologs={col}  identity={ident[i]:.2f}")

print("\nIdentity of P4-P4' block (429-436): %.2f" % ident[429-w0:436-w0+1].mean())
print("Identity of stalk 433-488:           %.2f" % ident[433-w0:488-w0+1].mean())
print("Identity of TM 489-509:              %.2f" % ident[489-w0:509-w0+1].mean())
print("Identity of whole window:            %.2f" % ident.mean())

# furin motif check in every ortholog around the SU/TM region
print("\n=== Furin R-X-[KR]-R consensus anywhere in each ortholog ectodomain ===")
for a in accs:
    hits=[(m.start()+1, S[a][m.start():m.start()+4]) for m in re.finditer(r'(?=R.[KR]R)', S[a][:490])]
    print(f"  {names[a][:24]:<26} {hits if hits else 'NONE'}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4))
x=np.arange(w0,w1+1)
ax.bar(x, ident, width=1.0, color=np.where((x>=433)&(x<=488),'#38a169',np.where((x>=489)&(x<=509),'#e53e3e','#a0aec0')))
ax.axvline(432.5,color='k',lw=2)
ax.text(432.5, 1.06, 'Q432/R433', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.15); ax.set_xlabel('human residue'); ax.set_ylabel('fraction of 10 orthologs identical to human')
ax.set_title('ERVMER34-1 ortholog conservation across the shedding site, the 56-aa stalk (green) and the TM (red)')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
